Title: Butoh Dance Laboratory
Description: ¿Butoh? Discover an active meditation in which every movement, each second, all sensations, feelings and images arouse in your body summoning an overwhelming monument to human experience. Inspired by this art form that began in post nuclear Japan we enact inner light and shadows trough somatic body dynamics and hypnotic poetry plunging our conscience into the realms of waking dreaming alongside the veteran dancer from Zaragoza Gonzalo Catalinas.

Title: Punk Nutrition for Nomads, Rebels, and People Without a Fridge
Description:
¿Qué comer sin nevera ni cocina, sin vivir de Doritos? ¿Qué necesita un humano para sobrevivir una semana en el desierto? Si tu dieta depende de suplementos, batidora y wifi, tenemos que hablar. Prometemos preguntas, algún juego, herejías nutricionales y cero kale masajeado.
What do you eat with no fridge or kitchen? We’ll talk survival, impossible diets, games, and nutritional heresy. No Doritos, no massaged kale.

Create a tiny frozen masterpiece. Decorate the dome. Embrace the absurdity.

Title: Role fluid Salsa dancing!
Description: Are you an absolute beginner in Salsa? Have you ever dreamed of trying but always been too shy? Have always been a leader/follower and would love to try the other role? Then this workshop is for you!  We are gonna teach the basics of salsa from scratch and then put it together in a nice and fun circle that is called Rueda de Casino :) Everybody is welcome, no previous experience needed!

Yin Yoga for the most relaxed dusty creatures. Use whatever you like to become as much relaxed as possible before you come. BYO mats!

Join us for a 40-minute relaxation session as we stretch our muscles into all sorts of unique poses! Musicians are highly welcome to come play live music and set the vibe.

Title: Barrio del Cambio Party
Description: What do neighbours do on a first date? They throw a double-camp PARTYYY!! Join us and meet the monster baby created by the wild collaboration between Barrio del Sol and Camp Cambio! We'll start at Barrio del Sol (20:30 - 22:30) and then Camp Cambio (22:30-00:30).

Title: Live ASMR
Description: Have you ever wondered whether you can experience ASMR in real life? Well, your next adventure awaits! Join for cozy, small-group sessions where we dive into the possibilities of live ASMR. Let's experiment with sounds, share the relaxation, and discover whether we can make each other tingle.

Description:
The performers are already here. You just don't know who they are yet.
""Cabaret of strangers""  is an immersive night where the dancefloor is the stage. Hidden among the crowd, performers are waiting for their moment — and when it comes, the music shifts, the space transforms, and something unexpected takes over.
No announcements. No curtain. Dance. Watch. Or become part of it.

Description: Paint the town pink with us! Start Elsewhere as you mean to go on and join us to shake off the default world at our playful Jugaton dreamland party. Put on your rose-tinted spectacles, grab a pink drink, and find your inner bubblegum with music to shake your flamingo tail feathers to, tutti-fruity conversations, and cotton-candy sweetness. Pink outfits are encouraged. Come get tickled pink—we might even make you blush...

Title: No Elephants Night
Description: A night out at Elsewhere starts at Glitch! And so should your burn. Stumble into our little black tent for a night of fine French techno mixed with questionable life choices. Rated 4 out of 5 stars by Barrio Review because “they lack a bar and should play psytrance,” we're proudly doubling down on our shortcomings and working toward our well-deserved 3-star review in 2027.  As always only one rule applies: Strictly no Elephants

Description: Engage in a collective tactile exploration through the skin. Without sight nor hands, we will open our senses to connect, guided only by our perceptions. Starting from contact improvisation and authentic movement, immerse in a collective dance. If we then move towards shared pleasure among the whole group, it will be pure chance.

Title: Rüber’Town’s Opening Party
Description:
Did your usual church collapse under its own updates, subscriptions, and surge-priced salvation tiers? Be relieved: the Church of Rüber'Town is rising for lost souls*.
Congregants will celebrate the Post-Apocalyptic Chaos with deep bass and booze.
Warning: this is not a cült.

Title: Orgy: Queerious
Description: Feeling Queerious? Come explore in a soft, welcoming space for anyone discovering their queerness. We start slow — grounding and gentle connection — so you can relax, meet cuties, and feel your way into the vibe. No pressure, no 'queer enough' test: just curiosity, consent, and community as energy builds toward something playful and spicy. First time or just looking for something slower — all are welcome.

Title: Matriarchal Orgy
Description:
Here, women, and people subjected to sexism, take power. They choose, lead and set the rhythm. Men become objects of desire, devoted to their pleasure, their rules and their desires.
A collective, sensual and consensual space where femx domination reigns. Sexuality is allowed, never mandatory.

Requirements
Having participated to consent workshops.
Identify and communicate your limits.
Absolute respect for consent and everyone’s boundaries.

Title: Sensual reconnection
Description: Want to add a little softness and spark to your intimacy? In a warm, friendly, and sensual atmosphere, explore new soft ways to connect and delight your partner. For couples only.

Title: Welcome to the Nest
Description: A temporary sanctuary woven from sound, connection, and shared energy. Nestled among deep downtempo grooves, organic rhythms, and immersive melodies, this is a place to land, unwind, and reconnect. A warm cocoon where strangers become companions, time slows down, and the music gently carries us together through the night.

Take a seat and come along for a wild ride through 100+ years of adult entertainment. From pre-Disney dark animation, through vintage loops, to the kinky and queer creations of today. In between, you might find full-length feature or a spontaneous live show!

The night fades, the sun rises over the dust, and it's time to gather around one of life's greatest pleasures: crêpes and mimosas.

Join us for two hours of delicious crêpes, sparkling mimosas, and easy morning connections with fellow burners. Whether you're fresh from sunrise adventures or slowly returning from the night before, come share stories, laughter, and a moment of simple joy before the day unfolds.

Title: Morning silent meditation

This non-guided session is perfect for your personal practice (Vipassana, Anapana, Jhana) or for those simply seeking stillness. To respect the shared immersion, we avoid noisy breathing or any disturbances. Just enter, sit, and be.

This is a session for all longtime Nobodies and new Elsebodies who are somewhat confused about what is happening with our beloved event.
We will talk about the new underlying structure, how to better participate to keep the event going and what it all means for the future of this dusty and important place in our lives.
There will be punch and pi

Title: Muscles, Hands, and Trigger Points.
Description:
A beginner's introduction to palpating muscles under varying degrees of tension.
 
How do muscles run and how do I massage them comfortably? What are trigger points and how do I find them? And how can I massage them?
 
 Bring a towel or other mat. You can stay and practice for 1h extra after the workshop.

Title: How to make your barrio more inclusive?
Description: This workshop will be led by the inclusion team of Elsewhere. We will provide tips and tricks on how we can step up as barrios to make people feel more at home. You're welcome to bring your cases also. Welcome to everyone, candy for campleads that free up their time to come share and learn! Maybe you can try to implement some little things this burn already aaaah!

Title: Reject Nihilism and Preserve Hope with Decentralized Tech
Description: Nihilism is part of the current zeitgeist. It’s natural to feel it, and easy to give in. But avoiding the worst outcomes depends on us collectively resisting nihilism so we can build a better future. I’ve spent 30 years thinking about freedom tech, and I think the tools are now here to help us steer away from Orwellian control and toward freedom... and hope. Let’s talk about the tools and what freedom without centralized systems can look like.

Title: Oneiria's Eyes: Exploring Dream Symbols
Description: Discovering slumber’s domain, star-spots of delicious symbolic daylight splinter a night sky’s silence: radiant dreams swirl wild through our half-naked, unawakened awareness. A mad poet will share some Jung-inspired dream analysis techniques, focusing on finding personal meaning in our dreams - bring some dreams with you, especially those you kinda already understand! Little demonstration followed by small-group dream sharing/pondering!

Title: Thirsty for Love, Hungry for Freedom
Description: A playful and meaningful journey through paired movement, sound, and guided meditation to explore love, freedom, and the balance between giving and receiving. This workshop invites participants to connect with themselves and with others in a deeper way, awakening trust, playfulness, and human connection, while reflecting on an essential question: are you truly nourishing your own needs, or mostly feeding everyone else first?

Title: The Musical Chair Lap Dance
Description: Learn the art of lap dance and maybe win the once in a lifetime opportunity to have 20 peoples giving you a lap dance at the same time.

Title: Shibari Without Rope
Description: Discover the tension, connection, and dynamics of Shibari without using a single piece of rope! In this 1-hour session, we will explore mindful restraint, connection, and sensory play using only everyday objects. This is a relaxed and accessible space to learn about the principles of tying and tension in a completely different way.

Title: Morning Jam
Description: A cup of morning coffee, a freshly toasted bread with home made preservatives.

Title: Run, Sweat and Sniff: Wild Pride
Description: Run with the pack, sweat like animals, sniff deep. A high-intensity fitness and fetish event for a brotherhood of men who worship raw masculine scent. We start with a 5K run together, then crush a bodyweight workout to get the pheromones flowing. Once the sweat is earned, a fully consensual space opens for guys to explore pit fetish and indulge in the intoxicating aroma of the pack. No deodorant, antiperspirant, or cologne.

Title: Dance theatre workshop: guided improvisation and instant composition
Description:
The workshop is open to everyone.
We will begin with a gentle warm-up. This will involve connecting with ourselves, with others, and with our environment. Then we will explore instant composition collectively, keeping this question in mind: where does theatre begin/end?
A safe place to let yourself be guided, to express your creativity without thinking, to let your intuition take over, to let your body move and speak.

Title: Science for Hippies, Spirituality for Nerds
Description: Ever wonder why optical illusions work? Our brains weren't wired to show us reality, but to survive. We are essentially hallucinating our experience! In this workshop, we'll use cognitive science to expose our mind’s glitches, and spiritual practices to break free from our mental programming. Ultimately, we'll explore how skeptical and mystical tools complement each other to achieve the same goal: understanding reality.

Title: Bad Meditators
Description: Think you suck at meditation? Always feeling like you are failing at it and avoiding it? Come and discover why you are actually doing great! This intro class to mindfulness meditation can be your first step to a steady practice, releasing self judgment and a portal to accepting the present moment (and at Elsewhere it's a pretty good moment...)

Title: Not pulpo spa
Description: Hair... brushing them, pulling them, braiding them, getting lifted by them... There is lot of ways to appreciate them or to make someone appreciate them, and a lot of play that we can have. This workshop is a time to take care of them in a kinky way. This is mostly meant for the hair on the head though :)

Title: Beyond Ejaculation: TAOist Sexual Practice for Men
Description: Taoist sexual practices — also known as "sexual kung-fu" — give men the ability to separate orgasm from ejaculation, enabling multiple orgasms and continuous energy without recovery time. Learn to circulate sexual energy and deepen body awareness. Hosted by two long-time practitioners sharing personal insight. For penis-owners of all orientations; all genders welcome. No nudity or sexual activity.

Title: Stretching
Description: Wake up the body. Get it ready for the day. I will guide you through some mobility exercises and stretches.

Title: Kink your workout
Description: Get in shape with bodyweight and acro movements, all the while doing fun stuff with your and other (no) bodies. We will mix yoga, calisthenics, acro, and being playful with other humans. Plank while trying to spank or avoid getting spanked. Squat or push with another human straddled on top. Wrestle your way out of being pinned. Do your handstands or you will get spotted the hard way...

Title: Este maquillaje es la caña! Artistic makeup workshop
Description: Taller de maquillaje artístico. Ven a disfrutar con Rachel y Seta de un maquillaje facial o corporal con preciosos motivos orgánicos inspirados en la naturaleza. El maquillaje geométrico se centra en líneas precisas y figuras abstractas para crear simetría y arte visual. El biomecánico, inspirado en la ciencia ficción y el arte cyberpunk, simula la fusión entre la carne y la tecnología (engranajes, cables y metal). En castellano y francés

Description: Do you want to dance and express yourself but are you rhythmically challenged? Then come to Dancing For Dummies! I can help even the most stiff Nobodies to let loose and make sure that the rest of the burn, you will impress everybody on the dance floor!

Title: Ayurvedic Face Massage
Description: Revitalize your Playa-worn soul through the ancient Ayurvedic ritual of face massage. In this partner-based workshop, we trade the Playa Mask for a radiant glow. Learn to activate sacred Marma points, release deep-seated tension, and connect with a fellow Burner through the power of conscious touch. From dust to stardust, refresh your face, reset your spirit.

Title: Polyamory Speed Dating
Description: Are you a lonesome heart? Tired of searching for your soulmate with no luck? Stop looking for your better half and improve your romantic efficiency. Come to our Bread & Tomato polyamorous speed dating and make the best gazpacho ever! You may fall in love with several people at once, you may find your perfect quad for the roman orgy, you will return home with a dozen in-laws, or maybe not. But you’ll have a great time for sure!

Title: Queer men's circle
Description: An invitation to everyone who identifies as a man to join our Queer Men Circle, an open conversation on queer/gay/bi topics. Come participate, add your point of view or just listen and learn from others.

Title: Meet other folks from la ville rose
Description: Toulousaine ? Toulousain ? Come and meet other folks from the pink city to keep the Elsewhere energy at home. (all Occitanie is more than welcome)

Title: Radical Purresence
Description: Presence and verbal communication workshop for Here & Meow crew. A way for us to get closer as a camp, create safe space for each other and find our authenticity. We will slow down, properly pay attention to each other, and practise saying the slightly truer thing than we normally would.

Title: Snow Day - Snow Cone Social
Description:
The desert is hot. The penguins are concerned.
Stop by for freshly shaved ice, cold treats, and the increasingly rare experience of holding frozen water in your hands. Enjoy a snow cone while contemplating a future in which they may become a luxury item.
Flavors available while supplies last.
Existential dread available indefinitely.

Title: Body Body massage
Description: Still using your hands to massage someone ? Not anymore ! Come learn how to massage and have fun with your WHOLE body. Yes, as I said, your WHOLE body.

Title: Mute check - special QUEEN edition
Description:
A Queen karaoke where the soundtrack randomly vanishes and leaves you singing into the void.
Can you keep the tempo alive and rejoin the music exactly when it comes back?
Maybe you're Freddie Mercury.
Maybe you're not.
There's only one way to find out...

Title: Before We Play: Conscious Connection at Burns
Description: How can we create intimacy that is conscious, sexy, clear, and caring? This interactive workshop introduces the „R.B.D.S.M.A. talk“-framework: a simple check-in structure for navigating (new) connections and intimacy in sex-positive spaces.

Title: The Usual Improv
Description: Let's give newbies, veterans and cynics the chance to engage in the usual improv comedy theatre games because they are lightening the mood, lifting the heart, and preparing participants for dubious walking-act ambitions in the dust.

Title: Top Hats for Keepers of Tiny Tales
Description: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a Top Hat Librarian? Using up-cycled materials, we'll create our own top hats designed to carry tiny books on their brims, ready to be filled with mad ideas, sudden epiphanies, and nonsensical stories.

Title: The Skin I Live In (Touch, Illusion,Connection)
Description: We will discuss how skin can trick you through tactile illusions, why a stranger's touch feels different from a lover's and how skin can guide who you're attracted to through smell and touch before your brain has caught up.

Title: Hypnotic experience: free your playfull inner child
Description: A playful hypnosis journey into curiosity, imagination and freedom. Through light trance states, imagination exercices, movement, duo and group interactive games, we will explore different inner states of our playful alter ego inner child like curiosity, childlike wonder, spontaneity, freedom, mieschief, creativity. To reconnect with the playful parts of ourselves often forgotten in adulthood. Just exploration. No hypnosis experience needed.

Title: Sensual bachata
Description: Will show the basics of this dance with another person, basic moves, and little coreography. If there are experienced people coming I can increase the difficulty.

Title: Leave your trace
Description: Come get your shoe soles stamped to leave your mark on the beach.

Title: Naked Sardana
Description: Tired of using clothes and eager to dance in the most tribal catalan way? Free your potorro and come to enjoy with us!! Sardana is the catalan national dance. Danced in circle, with some magical and secret steps you'll learn in this workshop. We can't promise you're not coming back home claiming your own republic

Title: Fish Exchange - A Community Fish Redistribution Event
Description: Penguins traditionally exchange fish as a sign of affection, respect, and occasionally poor judgment. We invite you to participate in the inaugural Fish Exchange. Bring an item. Any item. A wonderful item. A useless item. A mysterious item that has somehow followed you across three countries and six moves. We place our fish into the communal fishing grounds before taking turns selecting new fish to adopt and care for. No actual fish required.

Title: The Anatomy of a Hug
Description:
Not all hugs are the same. Come explore the anatomy of a truly nourishing embrace: breath, presence, posture, relaxation, intention, and the subtle ways humans connect beyond words. Discover how a simple hug can become one of the most powerful tools for transformation in our relationships, our nervous systems, and our sense of belonging.

A slow, heartwarming journey into one of the simplest and most profound forms of human connection: hugs

Title: Navigating the Dark: Depression & Crisis Support
Description:
Trigger Warning: Depression, life crises, and dealing with suicidal thoughts. 
Most of us have experienced or will experience different levels of depression during our lifetime.
I will tell about my failed suicidal attempt, what led me to that, my recovery, and my insights from this tragic event. This workshop is also relevant if you don't have any suicidal thoughts or depression issues, and can help you or your friend.

Title: Fuego Tease: Dance, Desire & Diva Energy
Description:
Welcome to Camp Jugaton, where the rhythm is irresistible, the hips don't lie, and the energy is pure fuego. 

Come and awaken your spicy inner diva.

Expect ridiculously sensual bachata, sassy salsa, and juicy reggaeton grooves.

Together, we’ll flirt with fire and explore a few picante lap dance tricks to seduce or perhaps embarrass a beloved friend.

Title: Embodied intuition!
Description:
Your body is a compass. 

Let’s learn how listen to our bodies real ‘yes’s and ’no’s and be guided the wisdom collective intelligence together!

Reconnect to your real intuition in workshop exposing intuitive play.
This is not a sexual workshop.

Title: Queer Gestalt
Description: Through different dynamics, we will connect with our bodies, our needs, and each other. Exploring conscious touch, presence, pleasure, and authenticity, we'll create a space for queer folks to experiment with giving, receiving, and just being.

Title: ENM workshop Truth and lies
Description:
If I explore Ethical Non-Monogamy or polyamory, will I end up trapped in a polycule? What even is a polycule? Are ENM/poly people just sex-crazed cult wannabes? 🤔
This is a space to talk about what ENM means, bust preconceptions, and share funny assumptions & stories.
Time to share, connect, learn and laugh. 💛
Curious souls or seasoned ENM folks — all welcome.

Title: Ikigai — A Map to Your Purpose
Description: Ever felt like something is missing, or that you're not quite living the life you're meant to? Ikigai is a Japanese concept that helps you find where what you love, what you're good at, what the world needs, and what sustains you all meet. Through guided meditation, solo reflection and honest conversation, we'll help you map that intersection - and leave with more clarity on the direction you actually want your life to take.

Title: Where Tantra meets Tarot
Description: Meet your 5D Soulmate.. Learn about Psychic Energy.. Platonic touch, light or deep sharing, Fun with Tarot

Title: Introduction to Marriage Meetings
Description: For the last few years, my fiancé and I have been doing a weekly Marriage Meeting as developped by therapist Marcia Naomi Berger. It's a great tool to manage the relationship, prevent small issues to become big, and keep the link strong, and we want to share that simple tool with you!

Title: Leg Massage
Description: Would you like a relaxing and restoring moment after so much dancing and exploring? Join us for this amazing workshop and take pleasure in receiving and learning how to give a wonderful leg massage. We will work in pairs taking turns, so try to come with a partner.

Title: Communal Living: let's chat!
Description: Join us for a relaxed, informal space to discuss communal living. Share ideas, resources, and experiences. People at all stages are welcome - whether you're just curious or already living collectively.

Title: Speed drawing : the drawing speed dating

You want to meet people in an original way, join our revisited speed dating ! Get to meet some people through question to which you will (try) to answer by drawing !

Description: Every Sunday is Pancake Sunday. What started as a breakfast tradition evolved into a globally unrecognized religion. Since time is merely a suggestion at Elsewhere, Sunday will be celebrated on Wednesday. Pilgrims are invited to arrive topless (or fluffy), bearing toppings as offerings. Ask the Pancake Oracle to reveal what Elsewhere holds for you. New friends? Unexpected adventures? Only the pancake knows. Gluten-free and vegan available.

At the Crappy Cabaret, we’re looking for : An idea you have but don't quite know how it should go; A skill you want to show off but don’t have a stage; Something someone said could be cool, but who knows what it’s supposed to be? Audience members welcome, with one rule: We go wild cheering for everyone, no matter how the performance goes. This event is about embracing DONE, not PERFECT !

Description:
"
Your playa name finds you.. but sometimes it needs a little help. In this 60 minute workshop, we’ll use reflection, interaction and the wisdom of the people around you to uncover the name that captures who you truly are out here on the dust. This inside journey might bring outward a name to that sticks for life! "

Title: Connect, Feel, Share, Touch
Description: A body and dance practice workshop exploring conscious connection — with yourself and with others. Moving gradually from individual awareness to group contact, we discover each other's bodies through movement and skin, building a new vocabulary of touch. Come in light clothes if you can; as comfort grows, layers can be shed. A gentle, emergent, and consensual space for curious bodies.

Title: Sensual Connections
Description: Feeling curious? Wanting to connect? Join this 5-hour workshop to explore consent and create a safer space for sensuality and fantasy. We’ll connect physically, emotionally, and mentally with ourselves and others. Please arrive freshened up and on time, with a towel/blanket/yoga mat. Singles and couples welcome. Title: Astral Projection & Interdimensional Traveling  Workshop
Description: A guide to the galaxy that starts in your mind! Come learn about astral projection and traveling. I will guide you on your first experience and set you up for more. Even if you don’t manage to travel, it’s a great meditation technique or siesta that will have you feeling revitalized. We will be using “The Gateway Tapes” method. You will learn how to create a bubble to protect your energy among other Jedi mind tricks! Naps are welcome!

Title: Nude Constellation
Description: Nude Constellation is a movement workshop exploring the creation of collective nude body sculptures through contact improvisation, partner acrobatics, and acroyoga. We will build living compositions of intertwined bodies, exploring weight, balance, support, texture, and form. Alongside movement, pencils and paper are available for drawing and painting, allowing participants to sketch and document the evolving human landscapes.

Title: Breathwork for clarity
Description: Discover the magic of breathwork. Arrive tired and confused, leave connected to yourself and your intuition. The session will involve movement and a gentle breath. NB: you don’t actually need to be confused about anything to reap the benefits of breathwork.

Title: A refreshing way to Finnish

Once we reach our limit and are suitably glistening, we'll hit the pool for a cold plunge and ice beverage. As with any sauna, please do not attend under the influence of alcohol, substances or if you have a condition unsuited sauna heat. Please arrive showered and hydrated.

Title: Playback Improvisation Contest
Description: Become an international superstar at the Playback Improvisation Contest! Participants are challenged to  improvise performances of surprise songs from around the world using only lip-sync, attitude, and pure emotional commitment. No singing talent required: only courage, drama, and chaotic stage presence. Limited to the first 8 participants. Audience participation encouraged. Will you become the Playback Champion of Elsewhere!!

Title: Knot Tying 101 (I promise it's fun)

Title: It's Your Turn. Step Into Your Presence. Own the Room.

Step into the seat, speak with presence, own the room! even just for a moment. What you discover about yourself will stay long after the dust settles.

Description: You will get to know your inner demon which comes along with you to Elsewhere. Demons are very hungry, we feed them to satisfy and make them happy. You will notice that the demon is a very important part of you, which wants to be seen and nurtured. Expect drums and incense.

Title: Habibi Watermelon Disco
Description: We are BACK for another year of hip shaking and shoulder shimmying. Join us for two hours of the funkiest, grooviest Arab disco and house on the Playa, brought to you by South Lebanon's Katya La Mar. Title: Circle of trust

This is a surrendered experience - leave all your expectations at the door.

Title: Where contemporary dance meets the dance floor
Description:
Two worlds collide! The creative contemporary movement meets the freedom, rhythm, and pure joy of club culture. We'll explore initiating movement from different joints and centres of the body, playing with tension and release, relating to one another across distance, and discovering what lives between stillness and motion.
No experience needed. Just curiosity, a body, and a willingness to move.

Title: The Naked Dance Party

Description:
Initiation au jeux de rôle et au théâtre d’improvisation dans lesquels vous allez vivre une aventure par notre narration et vos choix détermineront la suite de l’aventure ! 
(activité animée en français)

Title: Make men* suffer - cock and ball torture <3
Description: Learn how to safely inflict pain on dicks and balls, with and without tools. Will have a theoretical and a practical part, you can come alone - no guarantee to practise.

Title: Blues Dancing
Description: Introduction to partnered Blues Dancing. Enjoy the connection with a dance partner and with the music! We'll rotate partners, but you can also come as an exclusive couple.

Title: Tantra massage for beginners
Description: Explore the four different elements of Tantra Massage: Earth, Air, Fire and Water. A sensual and fun way to connect and explore. Come with a partner or find one outside!

Title: Impact jam
Description: A dedicated space to practice, learn, and explore impact play in all its forms. Whether you're a curious beginner or an experienced player, come swing a flogger, crack a whip, exchange skills, or experiment with new techniques. Impact toys will be available to borrow, or bring your own favorites. Consent is at the heart of the space, with experienced angels on hand to support participants and help keep everything safe, respectful, and fun.

Title: The Five Seconds Workshop (duration: 5 seconds)
Description: Workshops are the foundation of the classic Elsewhere (an event happening for the first time ever) experience. Let's get straight to the point: You have a lot to do, and so do I. With this workshop, we’ll tick off the to-do item of attending at least one workshop early in the week and with minimal time investment. Reading this description already took you longer than the workshop will. Attendance only counts if you're there from beginning to end.

Title: Clandestine Dinner
Description:
An inter-camp conspiracy of connection, cuisine & farandula 🌙
Hidden from the chaos and clamor, a few kindred camps conspire for magic. You're invited to a clandestine culinary experience: a multi-camp Secret Supper at an undisclosed location on the playa.
No signs. No address. Only those in the know — or willing to follow subtle clues across the dust — will arrive. 🔥
Want a hint? Come early, ask at the yellow southwest square. Bring a Plate

Title: Talk: Let's Talk About Polyamory
Description: Two polyamorous partners share their story — the evolution from libertinism to polyamory, what they've learned about themselves and their queerness, the challenges (being left out of the polycule, the dramas — all in their heads?), and how they keep becoming more loving every day. Questions very much encouraged.

Title: Golden Hour Art Tour
Description: Officially escorted by official Everywhere Art Council Team(!) –  Join a sunset pilgrimage across the playa to witness this year's creations, eavesdrop insider art-admin goss, collect inspiration, and gain highly questionable access to the Art Team of Elsewhere.  Recruitment for 2027 may occur accidentally. Note: approximately 2,460 emails were sacrificed in the making of this year's art coordination. Optional fire-jumping on departure.

Title: Trust obstacle course
Description: Come in a pair and one person will direct the blindfolded other through an obstacle course.

Title: We Olive You So Much: A Playa Feast
Description: Hey dusty family, the Olive Odyssey crew wants to feed your beautiful faces with a mouth-watering Mediterranean feast right here in our barrio! Grab your trusty bowl and cup, bring your wildest playa stories, and let us fill your bellies.

Title: Ecstatic Dance
Description:
An immersive ecstatic dance journey that weaves together organic rhythms, world music, tribal grooves, downtempo and psychedelic soundscapes.
It invites participants into a deep exploration of emotion, and presence, guiding dancers through waves of grounding, expansion, release, and celebration through the power of music and movement.

Title: Shibari for true Beginners, One-rope shibari & Jam
Description: Have you always wanted to explore shibari but felt intimidated by its technical side? This workshop is designed for beginners who want to get started in a fun, relaxed way. You'll learn the essential skills needed to enjoy rope with your partner, discover the versatility of one-rope shibari, and finish with a guided free practice session (or 'jam') to experiment.

Title: Two boys, one girl
Description:
This workshop is about creating opportunities for consensual threesome connections, for mascs,fems and thems. Whether you're dreaming of 2 boys, 1 girl or any other threesome dynamic, except Cishetmen + FF. Come curious, playful, and open to exploration. Phase 1: Find your match. Phase 2: Do your match

The 2 facilitators will actively participate in the workshop alongside everyone else. 2 angels will also be present to watch over the space.

Title: Massage : the Colors of Eros. A journey into sensuality and playfulness
Description: Come in pairs. This workshop is going to be an exploration of the different kinds of energies you can bring into touch, symbolized by colors. It's going to give you a lot of ideas on how to ignite and attend to someone else's pleasure.

Title: Open Mic
Description: SHOW US WHAT YOU GOOOOT. Put your name on the list. Do you thing. Let us know if you want to perform, so we can save a space for you ;)

Title: Forest bathing in the desert
Description: Time to pause, breathe, notice and appreciate. We immerse in nature in a guided slow walk that we connect with our senses, away from noise and into the beauty of silence, touch, soft light and desert nature. This is the time for you to connect with the desert and yourself and calm your nervous system. Come to find peace and beauty! Note: there is no forest and no bathing included in this activity! Bring your water and curiosity!

Title: The Procession of the Golden Woman
Description:
Wanna be part of a cult for only one night ? You have questions ? We have answers. 
Once a year, if the Nobodies have prayed enough, the Golden Woman rises from the Dust.
Join the procession as she crosses Elsewhere, bringing abundance to all who walk beside her. Offerings, songs, prayers and golden intentions are welcome. Spread the Gold, Join the Cult.

Title: The golden party
Description: The Golden Woman is back on the playa. The celebration begins. Gather beneath the golden glow for a night of music, dancing, and abundance. The Golden Woman will be among her followers celebrating abundance and truth of life. Golden attire is encouraged. Spread the Gold, Join The Cult.

Title: Bureaucratic sunset
Description: have u ever dream to fill forms while the sun goes down? Join Our friendly TUL-clerks that will make you fill out fascinating forms, wait around just to send you back to your barrio, and then make you come back again. Yes! This is the paradise you dreamed of!  Come and tell our office workers to their faces all those nasty things you never dared say to your favorite bureaucracy office.”

Title: Elise's birthday Temple of Love
Description: Step into a sacred space of connection, presence, and celebration as we gather for a special Temple of Love honouring Elise's 35 birthday. Through heart-opening encounters, authentic relating, touch, music, and shared presence, we create a container where vulnerability, playfulness, and intimacy can unfold naturally.

Title: (Indie) Pop Music Party
Description: Are you a fan of live music and aren't sure where to find it at Nowhere? Singer-songwriter, pink-pop-princess 'Alina' will be performing some covers and originals at the Middle Of Nowhere so come along to listen, dance, discover and enjoy

Title: Great Desert Wedding
Description: Come dressed for a wedding. Yes, for a collective wedding ceremony where everyone is invited, everyone belongs, and everyone is part of the celebration. Expect vows, absurdity, and dancing! Till Sunset Do Us Part.

Title: British Museum guided tour
Description: Missing an art piece that belonged to your beloved barrio culture? You should have perhaps taken a little more care. But don't you worry, you can admire it in its rightful place. We will be delighted to give you a tour of our discovered treasures, along with with the stories of their origin. Did we fact check them? Good heavens, no.

Title: Aprons and Flowers
Description: An evolution of ancient garden tradition, this year we bring you a floral banquet of bare asses and tasty delicacies, dancing all night in a sea of booty and beauty. Bring your asses and your best flowers! We will offer food and Free drinks till it last. Start the night, where the party will be! Powered by Funktion One Soundsystem!

Title: sensual caressing meditation
Description: From the Osho school of Tantra, it is a gentle and loving exploration of touch and awareness. It is done with a partner and has sensual elements but is not explicitly sexual.

Title: Volunteers meetup and party
Description: Do you do too much during the year or just one shift during the event ? It doesn't matter, you make elsewhere possible ! Come and meet the rest of the crew at Werkhaüs !

Title: Free Art Tour
Description:
Why visit le Louvre, when the best art pieces are right in front of you on the playa?

Join our free walking tour for the answers that you didn't know you needed, to all your questions that you didn't think you had. We’ll share real and less real facts whilst strolling the playa. Leave slightly more informed and pleasantly confused.

Meet in front of Camp Cambio and look for a beautiful umbrella. And don't forget to bring a pretentious drink.

Title: Sloth Orgy
Description:
Let's...get...it...hot...in...here... !
We...sloth... usually...like...to...rush...things...but...this...orgy...will...be...slow...and...sensual. Prepare....for...
Oh...is...it...already...over ?

Title: Thunderdome Trampoline
Description:
Still stressed from build? Need to let of some steam?
Let's have Madmax Thunderdome style  fights on the trampoline! Bring out your dark sides (appropriate attire welcome)!
"Two burners enter, one burner leaves!"

Title: Kinky Techno Circus
Description: Welcome to our one night kinky rave galore. Think of this as Nowhere's version of your favorite kink event, garnished with some fine up-tempo electronics. Bring your outfits, tools, and longings. Get deep on our dancefloor and explore our play space. It's up to you how far you go - but always remember, the circus comes to town for one night only !

Title: THE Guided Play Party
Description: For new and experienced sexy humans alike, we start with simple icebreakers to build comfort and connection, then open into a safe, consent-led environment for play, curiosity, and kink. Expect a mix of lightness and intensity, always grounded in respect and boundaries. All welcome. Couples prioritised; singles can join the line. We’ll include as many as possible while preserving the mix. Please bring a towel.

Title: Outer Limits (DJ Set)
Description: Outer Limits - Weird Dance Music bridging Electro-Art-Pop and Leftfield Electronic music; Dance into an Unknown Future (feat the likes of Mandy Indiana, Deaths Dynamic Shroud, Fever Ray, Jockstrap, PVT, Autechre, Death Grips, et al)

Title: Queer Strip Club
Description: A mixed-gender queer space (no cishet people) for practicing lap dancing, striptease, and negotiated sexuality

Title: Foxes & Hounds
Description: The Foxes are cunning, quick, and already three steps ahead of you. The Hounds are relentless, hungry, and very motivated to catch up. Think you can outrun them ? Think you can catch them ? Two teams. One desert. Zero mercy.

Title: Crystal Love Ceremony
Description: In our annual ceremony we will guide you on a path to experience the bittersweet taste of pure joy and happiness as a connected group. We will start with an intro about what to expect before continuing with music and connecting exercises. Afterwards you are welcome to enjoy the party in the Wohnzimmer or free to wander into the night. Pass by before if you are unsure what to expect.

Title: ABCD° Orgy
Description: °All But Cis Dudes are invited to our ABCD Orgy. We co-create a spicy and safe space to get us all (consensually) going, wherever sparks and mutual desire may lead. Women, trans women, trans men, non-binary people — all welcome! (Cis = lives and identifies with the gender assigned at birth.)

Title: Neon Bodypainting
Description: Ignite your inner glow and let your creativity run wild under the stars! Step into our neon sanctuary to transform your skin into a vibrant, glowing masterpiece of light and color. Grab a brush, connect with others, and become a living canvas of the night!

Title: Glowy's world tour
Description: Follow the flight of the owl across borders, cultures, and rhythms. Guided by the sounds of distant lands, we journey through organic grooves, ancestral beats, and modern global vibrations.

Title: Happy Artificial Dancefloor
Description: We provide the sound beyond the burner mainstream. Speaking of stream: You can wet your whistle at our bar made from italian design furniture.

Title: Cosmic Love
Description: Step into Cosmic Love. Let yourself melt into the music: Fluffy beats, sparkly vibes.

Title: Psychedelic Breathwork
Description:
Join a journey where breath is the key to elevate. It’s an intense one-hour drug free workshop, in which one can feel the effects of deep relaxation and dreamy feelings (almost like on psychedelics!), only with breath and suggestion. 
(The workshop might be done mainly in French)

Title: Instant noddles
Description: Come enjoy a comforting bowl of instant noodles in the middle of the night, topped with extra ingredients. Suitable for vegetarians, those with gluten intolerance, and chili lovers

Title: Elsewhere Marathon
Description: Early morning 42,195 km run around perimeter (10 km x 4) and across the playa. Run whatever you want, one lap or more, or just a few meters. Start and finish line at Pink Poney Paradise. Costumes welcome. Theme of the year : pink up your life ! Supposed to start at 5 AM, ending around 9.30 AM. After party with fresh beers and free gurkins.

Title: Breath, Body and Stillness
Description: This workshop begins with heart coherence breathing, using a steady rhythm of breathing in for 5.5 seconds and out for 5.5 seconds to regulate the nervous system and create inner balance. From this grounded state, it moves into trauma release exercises to help the body discharge held tension and stored stress. The session then closes with a stillness meditation, allowing space for integration, calm, and deeper connection within.

Title: Desert Fitness
Description: Gentle morning reset with simple movement and stretching for people who are dusty, stiff, and under-slept. Less bootcamp, more humane reassembly.

Title: Gentle gymnastics, heart coherence, relaxation
Description: Energy exercises, meditation, the ritual of the 7 Tibetans, breathing and Lenten movements.

Title: Jugaton's Golden Cafe
Description:
A shaded oasis of Turkish coffee, sweet herbal tea, dates, cookies, and desert hospitality.

Be welcomed by a golden oracle and receive a random blessing, prophecy, or quest for the day ahead.

Pull a tarot card, challenge a stranger to backgammon, or take a seat at the Royal Throne for a little foot pampering and royal treatment.

Title: Do you want to be Elsewhere?
Description: Nowhere you feel present? Come to our peer sharing circle on FOMO. Quick grounding, curious questions, and structured exchange organized in a small group. Let's help each other feel seen, connect, and make here and now the best experience.

Title: Writing: a way to free your mind
Description:
Whether you're a seasoned writer or a total newbie, this workshop is there to help you write and observe.

We want to show you that anything can become a story.

Observe and let this focus and your imagination overtake you. It could become:
A type of meditation to let your mind wander.
A deep dive into your own experiences and feelings.
A warm-up routine before writing your novella, novel, news piece or a script.

Title: 12-bar jam
Description: Do you know how to boogie-woogie? Learn what that really means, and play around with the ubiquitous 12-bar blues progression, the most useful riff to know for blues and old-school rock & roll.

Title: Dance! But different. Connect to yourself through movement
Description: You love to move, but you don’t know dance steps, and really don’t care for strict rules anyway? In this morning-dance-meditation-combo you’ll listen to your body, wake it up fall into the connection with yourself, and maybe others. Yes, with music and No, no skills required.

Title: Healing Through Consent
Description: Ever had difficulties saying "no" to stranger or loved ones? Or uncomfortable in receiving compliments, or in receiving criticism? Come to this safe space where to learn and practice consent techniques that will allow to finally overcome everyday struggles. For everyone that feels ready to start listening their body and stop the chitchat in their mind.

Title: Power pranayama
Description: Breathing exercises to wake up and get activated. If you have, bring a yoga mat, if not something to sit on, also a water bottle with a small towel.

Title: Present Moment Meditation
Description:
After the first magical nights, this space is an invitation to fully arrive and reconnect with the present moment, to experience life more deeply and consciously.
We’ll gently wake up together through presence, breathing, and body awareness, a soft reset to feel more grounded.
Then we’ll open a sharing circle to explore how presence can support everyday life.
No experience needed. Come cozy, dusty, sleepy, curious, exactly as you are.

Title: Yoga with Cacao - Grow the Heart
Description: An invitation to explore asanas, breath and stillness. Create freedom in your body through twists, upper chest opening and sounds. Flow to feel good and reconnect to yourself. Yes we'll drink Ecuadorian Cacao! Not a ceremony. Max 15 Nobodies. Bring your cup, body and smile.

Title: Qi Gong
Description: Start your morning by breathing deeply, streaching gently, and easing into the day. Join us for a soft and energizing wake-up session before taking on the day. No equipement or experience required !

Title: Deepthroat from a receiver point of view
Description: Join in to exchange and perform along the concepts, techniques and feelings associated with providing spot on pleasure for the pleasure of providing it and providing it in knowledge of key locations, associated pressure, pace and depth

Title: Random Workshop
Description: Come and join us for a random workshop. We do not yet know what we will do. Maybe YOU end up giving a workshop, maybe you regret this decision for the rest of your life, but that is rather unlikely

Title: Open talk on Microdosing
Description: Come and ask your questions about Microdosing, or share your personal journey on how tiny things can have a big impact :)

Title: Neck-shoulder massage
Description: different ways of massaging / triggerpoints / how to communicate in massaging somebody and how to respond

Title: The body as an expressive being
Description: A guided workshop to experience the thinking body. The score is to work on a topic that each participant chooses beforehand. Working in pairs they will explore the expressive possibilities that unfolds from this starting point. Music and silence will assist the process.

Title: Shibari : jam and discovery
Description:
Everyone is welcome: solo participants, pairs, experts, beginners, and anyone who’s curious...
For those interested, we’re offering an introductory session where we’ll cover safety rules, how a session goes, and some basic knots.
For those familiar with shibari, there will be opportunities to play, chat, learn, and share experiences.
The idea behind this workshop is to adapt to everyone’s preferences and enjoy shibari together.

Title: Welcome to the Overthinking Club
Description: A cozy sharing circle for anxious humans and OCD minds. Come exchange stories, survival tricks, and moments of unexpected brilliance from our wonderfully complicated brains. Special Elsewhere edition.

Title: Introduction to Non Violent Communication
Description: If you are interested in truely understanding yourself and your dear ones better, this workshop is for you. Non violent communication is the art of empathic listnening and honest communication, a precious tool (and a wider approach to life if you embrace it fully) to live more in peace with yourself and with everyone else that sourrounds you: family, friends, collagues.

Title: The morning reset
Description: Dust, dancing, and late-night adventures… is your body starting to feel the Nowhere magic a bit too much? Give yourself a moment of pure restoration at Barrio Espace to realign your energy. This session uses somatic release techniques, meditation, and intentional breathwork to clear the dust from your mind and body, providing the ultimate Thursday reset to help you thrive for the rest of the week.

Title: Naked Contact Improvisation
Description: Contact Impro is a type of dance where the movers engage in a point of contact and flow from one point to another - no steps required. Let's practice it free of clothes boundaries.

Title: Connecting our souls through mindfulness
Description: Join us for a journey into presence, connection, and shared awareness. Through guided meditation, music, and interactive partner exercises, we'll explore how mindfulness can help us move beyond the noise of our thoughts and connect more deeply with ourselves and one another

Title: 1001 ways to choke your lover(s)
Description: Do you love a hand on the throat ? This workshop is for those who want to experiment a bit further than that, with advice on how to do it as safely as possible.

Title: Dis-balance gender
Description: This society is full of stereotypes. Those in power love to put us into boxes so they can tame and control us. It’s time to break free from every cage and embrace new identities. Feel free to come as whoever you want to be. Bring clothes, accessories, or objects that can help you transform and play.

Title: Sex-Po Charades: Flirt & Mime It Out
Description: Silly, playful or naughty Charades with a sex positive tarot deck. Come guess, act, watch. There will be for all!

Title: Animal Movements Calisthenics
Description:
Calisthenics is derived from Greek and means "beautiful stregth". In this form of training, your body serves as your primary training tool.

The goal is not to perform impressive looking poses, it's a fun and challenging way to coordinate and engage all your muscles.

There're exercises for individuals, partners, and groups.

Title: Pulpo Spa
Description: Is it starting to become difficult to know where your body ends and the dust begins? We're proud of you for making it halfway through the week. Why not treat yourself to a pick-me-up and come get treated and pampered at Pulpo. We will be offering hair washing, massages, face masks, and really anything we can to help prepare you for another few days of madness.

Title: Some Like It Hot
Description: Extreme Hot sauce contest with prizes for the brave winners. Do you love spicy? Come and get some! A hot classic for all publics, a freak show with hot sauce tasting from mild to extreme. Who will be the Queen of the hot salsa this year?

Title: Kinky Gym
Description:
Rise and grind, and lube up those…joints! It’s time for Kinky Gym, a cheeky morning workout where fitness meets kink. 

Sweat, giggle, and maybe get lightly spanked - all in the name of “exercise”.

Title: GÜNTER YOGA
Description: I am GÜNTER, internationally respected yoga expert and magnificent physical specimen.  Join GÜNTER for vinyasa journey of powerful poses, focused breath and partner yoga of exceptional sophistication. You attempt balance. You attempt flexibility. Maybe you succeed. GÜNTER remain skeptical. My class not sexual, but maybe I use my whip if you do wrong!

Title: Sharing Circle
Description: It's mid-burn and whether it's your first time or the 10th, you probably experienced a lot, got inspired a lot, felt a lot and so if you want to share and hear what others have to say - come join!

Title: Après-Ski Party
Description: You spent all day shredding absolutely no slopes. Now it's time for Après-Ski. Join us for an afternoon of alpine luxury in an environment completely lacking mountains, snow, ski lifts, or any legitimate reason for ski culture to exist. Wear your finest ski goggles, vintage snow gear, faux-fur jackets, thermal underwear or whatever winter fashion survived the trip to the desert. Hot beats. Cold drinks. Questionable European club energy.

Title: Little Playground
Description:
Curious about ageplay and want to know what it is?
Suspect you have a little or caregiver personality?
Want to meet other ageplayers or just play? 
We're hosting a sweet meetup for everyone curious about our favourite kink.  
- Q&A about everything ageplay 
- Show & Tell: Bring your favourite toys and games
- facilitated group activities and games 
THIS IS A ROLEPLAY WORKSHOP FOR ADULTS

Title: Lingvo de Amo: Esperanto
Description: Ever wanted to speak a language created to bring people together? Esperanto unites open-hearted people all over the world through travel, culture, and human connection. Come and share a fresh beer and discover this beautiful, playful, easy-to-learn language with fellow burners, wanderers, and curious souls. Lingvo de amo. Venu malkovri ĝin. (Yes — that’s Esperanto too.)

Title: ∞ LATIHAN: Moving in the Unknown ∞
Description:
What happens when we strip away the costumes, looks, and visual judgments? Drop the armor and meet your fellow Burners in the dark. Blindfolded, we step into the unknown to experience pure, unfiltered connection. Stop looking, start feeling.
Bring: Blindfold/Scarf. 18+

Title: Yoga for better Sex
Description: Yogis have more fun. This Yoga class opens your body in the right places! Improve your athletic skills to become the best lover on the playa

Title: K Olympics Protest
Description: PROTEST ALERT: Middle of Nowhere — Thursday 12:45. Join us to stand up for equine dignity. Demand fair treatment for horses, independent judge testing, and an end to exploitative performances. Neigh means neigh. #FreeTheHorses

Title: Dating in the Dark!
Description: A Speedy Blind date, jump into this bubble and experience someone by listening as you get closer. (Limited blindfolds BYO if possible :)

Title: Vipassana Couple meditation
Description: Inspired by the teachings of Huma and Mukto, this intimate workshop for couples explores Vipassana meditation through presence, eye contact, and vital energy connection. In a safe and conscious space, participants will deepen intimacy, awareness, and energetic connection.

Title: Turn Men into Furniture
Description: The male kind are struggling with purpose in this modern world, but we have the solution. Men, come to this workshop and find your new calling as a side table, sofa or rug. Allow the female kind to relax and enjoy your stability and strength.

Title: Prepare an act for the cabaret!
Description: Want to perform in the cabaret but not sure what to do? Come join us for a collaborative creative prep session to co-create something unforgettable. All ideas, art forms and levels of talent are willkommen, bienvenue.e and welcome!

Title: THE Olympics
Description: The Fifth and Final Olympics from you friends @ Yes!  If you Know, you Know, otherwise asK someone who's been in previous years because reasons...  Slots open for a few contestants, apply in advance.

Title: Poppers and Snogging
Description: Join us for a guided tour into the world of poppers! Participants will sample a variety of poppers, with optional snogging and provide feedback on their experiences. No prior experience necessary. Bring your own poppers if you would like to add to the mix.

Title: Desert Portraiture Walk
Description: Would you like to come home from Elsewhere with a professionally shot desert portrait? Well then this is your moment! Join me on this short photography walk (camera provided). Off the playa, we'll find a quiet spot and shoot with the dusty Nowhere hills as our backdrop. We’ll work together to diffuse the harsh sunlight into beautiful, diffused lighting. Any and all creative/silly ideas are welcome on this one! Please come with full water bottles.

Title: Dino station
Description: Dinos are back and just missing a touch of color, a name and a story to get back to life. Let's help them!

Title: Vulva vino -Liquid love vulva owners only edition
Description: Let's get sensual together! Put on your blindfolds and enjoy a magical experience exploring our bodies with soft touch, lots of oil, trust and fun in a safe environment shared with vulva owners only. Please come showered and be on time.

Title: Penguin Mating Rituals
Description: Scientists have observed many fascinating penguin courtship behaviors. Most of them involve presenting attractive rocks. Join us for an afternoon of flirtation, connection, and mildly embarrassing social experiments inside the coolest dome in the desert. Whether you're seeking romance, friendship, co-conspirators, or simply someone to hold your drink while you dance, this is your chance. Bring a rock if you're serious.

Title: Nautical Knots
Description:
Spend an hour learning how to tie beautiful, practical knots for everyday life! 

Workshop host has been sailing for 10 years and is excited to share the beautiful world of nautical knots. This skill is useful for almost every situation!

Title: Cum and Make Sum Noise
Description: Workshops for partners of any age, gender, type of relationships - to practice using voice and noise during intimacy and sex. Get rid of the shame involved in being loud and proud

Title: HFFM - Hot Female Foot Massage™
Description:
Behind the slightly provocative title hides something surprisingly wholesome and very burner-compatible:
a playful and relaxing foot massage experience used as a memory anchor to explore and embody nine practical steps that can genuinely improve one’s sense of life, connection, and alignment.
It creates a lot of laughter, surprisingly deep conversations, and a few “wait… why is this actually making sense?” moments 😄

Title: Tantra for beginner : What is Love?
Description: You feel intrigued by Tantra but never tried it or just want to practice this soft and loving art in the desert, come join us ! This workshop will be a platonic exploration and direct experience of this feeling we call Love. Though different steps, we will go deeper and deeper in feeling and (re) discovering what Love is !

Title: Shamanic Dream Journey
Description: A journey into the subconscious mind, through breath, sound and visualization. Participants will be taken on a journey into the Dreamtime and work on techniques that can be used for lucid dreaming and astral projection.

Title: Pickleback Slapshots and Chokeslams
Description: COME GET BARRIO DEL HARDCORE!!! Want a slapshot? NOT SO FAST.  Show us your nonchalance at getting CHOKESLAMMED IN THE POOL, then show us your theatrical strength by doing the HARDCORE SLAMMING. Only those who impress our fierce judges will be inducted into our HARDCORE HALL OF FAME and receive the PICKLED WHISKEY SLAPPING GOODNESS. Hard rock and metal provided.

Title: Multisensorial Mosaic Mega Mystery Mission
Description: I was just trying to design a cheeky little game... but I accidentally created a mischievous mirror that reveals surprising truths about communication, collaboration, and collective confusion. Join the mission if you're into games, giggles, genuine connections, curious conversations, strategic silliness, topsy-turvy teamwork, colorful scarves, CNC lasers, delightful daydreaming, puzzling predicaments, or absurd amounts of adorkable alliteration..

Title: YES, AND… YASSS! Queer Improv Theatre (Part 1)
Description: Ready to shed your default-world skin and step into radical play? Drop the script and dive into the first session of a two-part queer improvisation journey. Through high-energy games, physical comedy, and spontaneous storytelling, we unlock absolute acceptance (YES, and…), radical presence, and cosmic connection. No theatre experience required — just bring your authentic self, your pronouns of the day, and your most playful energy.

Title: Kinky Olympics
Description: Are you the Kinkiest Creature of the playa?! Come to our Curious Creatures dome, form your team of fellow kinky creatures and battle against other teams in various hilarious sexy challenges to decide who will win the Kinky Olympics of 2026! Don't want to participate but love to enjoy the priceless view? Become part of the public and we will make sure there's a whole lot of sexy, fun and cocktails!

Title: The Kissing Lab
Description: Enter a seductive playground for curious minds and eager lips. As co-researchers, we explore the physiology of kissing — breath, rhythm, pressure, and response — through guided, lips-on “experiments”. Together we’ll test new techniques, feel deeply, and share discoveries as sensation unfolds. Consent, openness, and a hint of mischief required.

Title: Electronic Nap
Description: A guided electronic daydream. Close your eyes and embark on an imaginative journey to meet your inner teddy bear. Ambient and downtempo sounds, introspection, comfort and gentle wonder await. Bring something cozy and surrender to the ride.

Title: Face Clothespin Challenge

Title: Auto-hypnosis for begginers
Description:
Have you ever tried to find your totem animal during a chaman trip, but always fall asleep or get bored before the end ? This workshop is for you ! 
A logical step-by-step guide on how to let go, for the overthinker you are.

Title: Hyperflow Hair Academy

Join our Hair Alchemy Workshop and learn how to craft your own vibrant extensions from scratch. We’ll guide you through the process so you can braid, style, and bloom into your most fabulous festival self. No experience needed.
🧵🌈 Sit, create, connect, and let your colors flow wild 🌈🧵

Title: Fiesta Del Agua
Description: Got a dirty body and mindset and/or need a good scrub? Get washed over at Camp Cambio’s human car wash, then pop into Barrio del Sol’s pool next door. All while tuning in to the freshest music coming from both our camps. Sip on cava, beer and enjoy grilled cheese and gazpacho (while supplies last, don’t forget bring your own drinks too!)

Title: Joint Crafting
Description: Learn how to roll your first 420 or get your skills to the next level. Study new, unique and creative ways to smoke up. B.Y.O.W! Professionals welcome, share your knowledge.

Title: Saw What?! — Learn to Play the Musical Saw
Description:
Ever looked at a saw and thought: “This could be more emotionally unstable”?
Come discover the eerie, beautiful, slightly ridiculous world of the musical saw. 
We’ll bend metal, summon ghostly melodies, and prove that even hardware-store tools can have feelings. 
No musical experience required — just curiosity, ears, and a willingness to make the desert sing.

Title: Own your desires. They may come true.
Description:
You know what you want. You've just been told not to want it. 
Desire gets a bad rep. We shrink it, hide it, dress it up in excuses. 
This workshop invites you to stop apologizing for what you want and start listening to it. Through sharing, play, and honest conversation, we'll explore what it means to truly own your desires. We're naming it, claiming it, and owning it fully. No shame. No filter. Just you and what you actually want.

Title: HFFM — Hot Female Foot Massage™
Description: Behind the slightly provocative title hides something surprisingly wholesome and very burner-compatible: a playful and relaxing foot massage experience used as a memory anchor to explore and embody nine practical steps that can genuinely improve one’s sense of life, connection, and alignment. It created a lot of laughter, surprisingly deep conversations, and a few “wait… why is this actually making sense?” moments

Title: Dirty Story Time

Once upon a time (two months ago, to be precise), I was kidnapped to the slums of Cape Town, but I managed to get back on time for lunch. You wanna know how? Come and listen! 


Stooooory time, folks!

Title: Become a cloud

Glitch calls on all you little wanderers, Rebel Rebels, and Thin White Dukes: put on your red shoes and let’s dance while Ziggy plays guitar, like in the golden years. No DJs, just hazy, cosmic jive. Title: The Seductress Archetype Play: Power, Presence, and Desire
Description: Exploration of unconscious patterns of attraction, presence, and power through the lens of Jungian archetypes - especially the Seductress.

Title: Entering the Dream: Yoga Nidra + Dreamwork
Description: This 2-hour workshop blends Yoga Nidra, somatic dream exploration, and communal reflection to explore dreams as lived experiences. Through guided practices and shared witnessing, we’ll step inside the dream world and listen for what wants to emerge. Bring a notebook, pen and a dream.

Title: Inner journey: guide and be guided
Description: Step into a calming, restorative inner journey. First, let yourself be guided — then become the guide for someone else. Bring your bestie or embrace the magic of connecting with someone new.

Title: Lick & Learn

Title: Glowy Love Boom Boom

Title: Secret Cabaret

Unfolding between fantasy and metamorphosis, this piece travels through ritual movement, sensual unveiling, and electric pulse — a journey into mystery, strangeness, and the feminine force beneath the dream.
